details:
Ever since the may 3rd update, voice audio works while people are loading, then drops completely when they load.
Once loaded, all users are also moving like they are experiencing low framerate and cannot hear my own voice audio. World audio is unaffected.
The log appears relatively normal during all points up to this message which tends to coincide with the loss of voice:
2021.05.07 02:23:49 Log - [Behaviour] uSpeak [1][938508098]: Segment playback time didn't match audio data length, audio cpu usage may be too high! - playbackTimeMS/audioLengthMS: 1115/600

2021.05.07 02:23:49 Log - [Behaviour] uSpeak [18][938508099]: Segment playback time didn't match audio data length, audio cpu usage may be too high! - playbackTimeMS/audioLengthMS: 1116/820

Expected: all users in an instance to load, move fluidly, and be able to hear and speak

Build 1089 did not correct this issue
title: Voice audio dropping upon instance load
